scenarios.label: Synthetic primary buck-boost converter stock-out
scenarios.purpose: Exercise stock-state handling and replanning. This is not a claim about real distributor inventory.

stock_override.source: synthetic demo event; not a supplier feed

expected_behavior: Apply the override only to this scenario/run; do not modify data/parts.json.
Do not select the overridden part while the out-of-stock state is active.
Re-evaluate remaining power candidates against the actual rail, input range, load current, thermal, footprint, and sourcing requirements.
Do not treat TPS63070 as a drop-in replacement for TPS63031; require design review and rerun affected electrical checks.
If no candidate passes the checks, report a structured failure instead of returning a success-shaped fallback.
scenarios.reset_behavior: Discard the run-local override when the scenario ends. The base catalog remains stock=unknown.
